notes:
****
- Home no longer freezes while live sports, films and the player all update at once
- When an episode finishes, the next one can start on its own
- Settings can pick a preferred soundtrack and subtitle language
- Playlist names can hide extra tags such as 4K and FHD
- Home can show trending films and series that are already in your playlist
- While you watch, you can search channels, open recent channels, lock the controls, and see stream info
- Live picture can fit, fill or stretch, and you can turn deinterlace on for old broadcasts
